deadline.value: Fall priority deadline is December 15; later packets are considered only if space remains.
deadline.quote: Fall - Priority will be given to complete application packets received by December 15th.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: Applicants should name faculty they want to work with and are encouraged to contact them before the deadline.
supervisor.quote: Applicants should list faculty in whose research they are interested and are encouraged to contact the faculty directly before the deadline.

funding.value: Most graduate students receive a teaching or research assistantship during the academic year.
funding.quote: The majority of graduate students in chemistry receive either a teaching assistantship (TA) or research assistantship (RA) during the academic year

entry_route.value: Any graduate of an accredited college or university may apply.
entry_route.quote: Any graduate of an accredited college or university may apply for admission to the Graduate School

notes: The department asks all non-native speakers for TOEFL or IELTS scores and does not mention the English-degree waiver, so the Graduate School rule is kept. Chemistry GRE is not mentioned on the admission page.
